Occurrences.Kwic: 佛祖髑髏穿一串，宮漏沈沈密傳箭。人天機要發千鈞，雲陳煇煇急飛電。箇中人，看轉變，遇賤則貴貴則賤。得珠罔象兮至道綿綿，游刃亡牛兮赤心片片。勘辨勘辨仰山寂禪師因溈山問：大地眾生業識忙忙，無本可據，子作麼生知他有之與無？師云：某甲有驗處。時有一僧從面前過，師召云：闍梨！其僧回首，師云：和尚！這箇便是業識忙忙，無本可據。溈云：此是獅子一滴乳，迸散六斛驢乳。草堂清云：古人臨機施設，出在一時，此是因風吹火，用力不多。當時若無僧從面前過，仰山將甚麼語驗他？不遇祖師端的旨，臨機開口卒難應。天童覺頌云：一喚回頭識我不？依俙蘿月又成鉤。千金之子纔流落，漠？塗窮有許愁。仰山問僧：甚處人？云：幽州人。師云：汝還思彼中麼？云：常思。

Yangshan Huiji owns the retained deployment: asked by Guishan how he knows beings have the busy drifting mind with no ground, demonstrates on a passing monk, calling out to him so that the turn of the head itself is the proof, winning Guishan's praise that this one drop of lion's milk scatters six bushels of donkey's milk.

Occurrences.Kwic: 發無量差別言詞。一一言詞有無量差別妙義。如上塵數衲僧。各各具如是口如是舌如是音聲如是言詞如是妙義。同時致百千問難。問問各別不消。徑山長老咳嗽一聲一時答了。乘時於其中間作無量無邊廣大佛事。一一佛事周遍法界。所謂一毛現神變。一切佛同說經。於無量劫不得其邊際。便恁麼去。鬧熱門庭即得。若以正眼觀之。正是業識茫茫無本可據。祖師門下一點也用不著。況復鉤章棘句展露言鋒。非唯埋沒從上宗乘。亦乃笑破衲僧鼻孔。所以道毫氂繫念三塗業因。瞥爾情生萬劫羈鎖。聖名凡號盡是虛聲。殊相劣形皆為幻色。汝欲求之得無累乎。及其厭之又成大患。看他先德恁麼告報。如國家兵器不得已而用之。本分事上亦無這箇消息。山僧今日如斯舉唱。大似無夢說夢。好肉剜瘡檢
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue. Dahui Zonggao owns the retained deployment: grades the imagined host of monks whose myriad mouths, tongues, and voices a single cough of the Jingshan elder would answer at once, each a buddha-work filling the whole realm of dharma, and rules that seen by the true eye all such bustling courtyard religion is exactly the drifting mind with no ground, useless by a hair at the patriarch gate, fit only to bury the school and split a patch-robed monk's sides.

Occurrences.Kwic: 有知音，後來僧持問曹山：未審是什麼病？山知他落著，便道：攢簇不得底病。這箇便是知音也。豈似而今無地頭恣意亂道，纔見人問：未審是什麼病？便打入葛藤窠裏，恰似拽鋸相似，你拖去，我又拽來，幾時得歇？於本參中有什麼交涉？這般病，諸人皆有之，只是不會病，酌然攢簇不得。既不會病，變成毛病去。既成毛病，只是業識忙忙，無本可據，到年窮歲盡，總無得力處，豈不哀哉！若踏著攢簇不得底病，便有超生離死之由。這僧又問：一切眾生還有此病也無？山云：有。僧云：既有，因什麼不病？山云：眾生若病，即非眾生。這僧也會推究，又問曹山：和尚還有此病也無？山云：老僧正覓起處不得，不妨險峻。這一句子，難道非曹山如何啟口？雖然，正覓起處不得，諸方具正知正見者
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1318.xml). Continued Essentials from the Sayings of Ancient Worthies. Ying'an Tanhua owns the retained deployment: raises Mingxi's incurable great illness and Caoshan's cannot-be-piled-up verdict as a true meeting of kindred tones, rules that everyone today has the same disease but does not know disease, and that once it turns stubborn it is the busy mind with no ground, stranded at year's end with nothing to hold, while treading the disease opens the way out of birth and death.

Pu'an Yinsu owns the retained deployment: sorts true teachers from false in his instruction, the false muddling form and emptiness and slurring word and silence, talking sutras without knowing the buddha's intent, their own consciousness a misty drift with no ground while they presume to untie prisoners and carry drunks, a thousand-year lampless room getting a splash of thick ink, a blind guide leading the whole band into the pit.

Miyun Yuanwu owns the retained deployment: tests his brothers on the first of the seventh month, whether they can raise the one without raising the two, since to raise it is every being's life no different from the life before them and to fail is the drifting mind with no ground, then raises Layman Pang's visit to Shitou and the hand over the mouth as the working of the birthless word.

Yinyuan Longqi owns the retained deployment: opens a seat at the west cloister for the north-mountain laity with learning and the way, learning short of attainment profitless and the way short of clarity a muddle, and the muddle the drifting mind with no ground, hard to free, before asking how the step before birth is attained and the step after burning made clear, and offering the pearl shining in the sea of birth and death.

Zhongfeng Mingben owns the retained deployment: in an instruction Chuiwan later raises, runs the cloth-shirt question through the place where one can enter no further, biding spirit at the impossible entry until subject and object both vanish and the lantern is kicked over and the pillars overturned, yet rules by the true eye that all this is still the drifting mind with no ground, while Chuiwan answers that the yaksa heart of yesterday and the bodhisattva face of today are not a thread apart.

Senses.Explanation: No ground to stand on, and the masters who say so of a drifting mind.
